title: Plan P2-007 resource governance contracts
businessObjective: Define deterministic workload budgets so AI and Staff workloads cannot exhaust or affect booking capacity.
technicalObjective: Write an exact finite P2-007 static resource-budget design, make its packet executable-ready, and prepare separately bounded exact validator admission; do not implement metering, queue, scheduler, provider, or production control.
assumptions: Budgets are static deterministic inputs, not live provider configuration.
No metric, budget, queue, workflow, scheduler, service, provider, data, or production state is accessed.
A separate task admits exact validator before P2-007.
acceptanceCriteria: Define closed V1 authority/policy with finite resource dimensions, 50/75/90 thresholds, hard-limit states, fresh/unknown/stale/inconsistent metering, fail-closed pause/requeue/block outcomes, booking isolation and workload limits.

Cover worker CPU/requests, queue operations, workflow steps, persistence size/growth/egress, runner minutes, AI invocations/tokens, notifications; batching/dedupe/idempotency/backpressure/rate/concurrency/retry/DLQ/priority/scheduled summaries.
Core private semantic interface imports no provider or infra; static validation cannot reserve capacity, schedule, execute, or alter production.
Update P2-007 exact paths/evidence/commands/deps and create GOV-054 exact admission task; no product artifacts implemented.
solEscalationTriggers: Any live quota/provider/metering/scheduling/queue action, booking capacity change, data or production behavior is out of scope.
rollbackExpectations: Revert only design/future packets/state/memory/evidence; preserve terminal records and external systems.

stateTransitions.reason: Created because P2-007 lacks finite executable design and exact validator admission.

Apply narrow independent-QA correction so every warning threshold fails closed before hard limit.
